payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all possible initial tree heights (1 to 1000), compute target arithmetic progression, count mismatches, and record operations for the best.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks each possible first height, making it a brute-force complete search. Among the given subtypes, search_backtracking is the most plausible label despite lacking recursion, as it systematically evaluates alternatives.
